source: Actual components with illustrative data; no independently drawn UI

pairs.title: Trial · limit popup
pairs.improvement: Explain the exhausted trial, automatic Pro date, price, and choice to wait.
pairs.note: Trial allowance policy comes from #15184; fresh paid usage comes from #15208.

pairs.title: Trial · in-chat notice
pairs.improvement: One neutral notice shows the start date and price; the draft stays editable.

pairs.title: Trial · exhausted allowance
pairs.improvement: One trial meter, the agreed renewal terms, and a clear option to start Pro now.

pairs.title: Trial · allowance remaining
pairs.improvement: One percentage for the whole trial, with an end date instead of a reset timer.

pairs.title: Pro · daily limit
pairs.improvement: Show the actual next plan, benefits, price, and the option to wait.

pairs.title: Pro · in-chat notice
pairs.improvement: Replace the generic billing detour with a contextual Max offer.

pairs.title: Pro · both limits reached
pairs.improvement: The later weekly reset takes priority; both usage windows remain visible.

pairs.title: Pro · weekly limit
pairs.improvement: Correct the daily-limit wording and identify the weekly reset.

pairs.title: Max · daily limit
pairs.improvement: Put the next usable time first, with a restrained capacity contact.

pairs.title: Max · in-chat notice
pairs.improvement: A calm reset notice and direct contact replace the generic billing button.

pairs.title: Max · billing and capacity
pairs.improvement: Group plan, usage, and capacity help; keep payment details compact.

pairs.title: Team · weekly limit
pairs.improvement: Identify the plan and blocking week; offer the appropriate support action.

pairs.title: Team · billing and usage
pairs.improvement: Usage and organization billing become a coherent page with capacity help.

pairs.title: Enterprise · weekly limit
pairs.improvement: Clear weekly timing and a direct route to the account team.

pairs.title: Enterprise · billing and usage
pairs.improvement: Bring usage timing and account-team support together with organization billing.
pairs.note: Current production already uses organization-managed Enterprise billing. This comparison does not claim to introduce that fix.

pairs.title: Basic · legacy-plan notice
pairs.improvement: A contextual Pro action replaces a generic billing destination.

pairs.title: Basic · legacy-plan settings
pairs.improvement: Keep the existing entitlement visible alongside usage and upgrade options.

pairs.title: No active plan · plan selection
pairs.improvement: Explain product benefits, prices, and billing choices before choosing a plan.
pairs.note: Monthly example for a trial-ineligible account. Annual billing retains its derived savings label.

pairs.title: No active plan · settings
pairs.improvement: Show account context and the path back to a subscription.
pairs.note: Production currently covers billing with its plan paywall; the proposal makes these settings accessible.

pairs.title: Trial ended · recovery
pairs.improvement: Explain ended access and offer a fresh start in the conversation.
pairs.note: Before: existing billing trial status. Production has no dedicated in-chat equivalent.

pairs.title: Trial canceled · recovery
pairs.improvement: Respect the cancellation and offer a low-pressure way to return.
pairs.note: Before: existing billing trial status. The sample cancellation has already ended access.

pairs.title: Payment failure · recovery
pairs.improvement: A dedicated action to recover the existing subscription.
pairs.note: Before: existing payment-method management card; production has no equivalent recovery popup.

pairs.title: Payment failure · settings
pairs.improvement: Bring payment recovery into the plan and usage summary.
pairs.note: Before: generic Pro billing; no dedicated payment-failure state. After: recovery only when billing confirms suspended access.

pairs.title: Usage unavailable · in-chat feedback
pairs.improvement: Explain the missing usage data and offer retry without displaying a false zero.

pairs.title: Usage unavailable · settings
pairs.improvement: Keep a visible usage error and retry action instead of silently removing the section.

pairs.title: Connected provider · continuation
pairs.improvement: Keep a connected-provider continuation option next to the upgrade.
pairs.note: Before: provider continuation exists in the popup, but not in the in-chat limit card.

pairs.title: Start Pro · payment review
pairs.improvement: Review the trial ending early, exact charge, and next payment before paying.
pairs.note: Sample billing quote. Actual charge, tax, period, and renewal terms come from Stripe. No invented card details.

pairs.title: Pro to Max · upgrade review
pairs.improvement: See the prorated charge, credit, tax, and renewal before upgrading to Max.
pairs.note: The quoted proration date is reused on confirmation. A failed preview offers retry and Keep Pro, never an unquoted UI charge.

pairs.title: Start Pro · payment processing
pairs.improvement: Wait for confirmed payment, entitlement, and usage reset before continuing.

pairs.title: Pro activated · return to work
pairs.improvement: Confirm successful paid activation and fresh allowances before returning to work.
pairs.note: Before: ordinary paid composer. After: the actual activation-success dialog; no equivalent exists in production.

pairs.title: Pro activated · fresh allowance
pairs.improvement: Show fresh allowances after confirmed trial-to-paid activation.
pairs.note: Illustrative before usage is carried over. After zero usage depends on the reset receipt and successful data refresh.
